question: _____ type of controllers have semiconductor sensors in Air conditioning system.
solution:
The correct answer is __Electronic**(Electronic Controllers)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Electronic controllers__ are commonly used in air conditioning systems.
 
• These controllers use semiconductor sensors to detect and manage temperature and humidity levels.
 
• They provide accurate and efficient control over the system's operation.
 
• Electronic controllers are more reliable and versatile compared to other types.
 
• They enable automation and advanced features, such as programming and remote monitoring.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Electric Controllers:**

 
 
• Operate using electrical signals or relays for basic on/off control.
 
• Lack advanced features compared to electronic controllers.
 
 
 
• **Pneumatic Controllers:**
 
 
• Use compressed air to operate.
 
• Commonly used in industrial settings but less precise compared to electronic controllers.
 
 
 
• **Hydraulic Controllers:**
 
 
• Use fluid pressure for operation.
 
• Mainly utilized in heavy machinery and not typical for air conditioning systems.
